what: Assembled box in its printed enclosure, 9 V supply, surround firmware, volume at maximum, unmuted.
stimulus: S/PDIF from an Analog Discovery 3 (tools/spdif_gen.py) into the DIR9001 coax input: 48 828 Hz, tones at -12 dBFS, 1017.3 Hz left, 1525.9 Hz right.
measured_with: AD3 scope, 10x probes on the RCA outputs, 50 kS/s, 4096 samples, first capture of each session discarded.

bench_test_firmware.note: bring-up, board on the bench, firmware/boardtest 1 kHz at -12 dBFS

in_the_box_spdif.note: fronts in surround mode, rears in 'stereo on all four' mode

matrix_test.mode: surround (rear = 0.5 x (L - R), 100 Hz - 7 kHz, 20 ms delay)
